newsitem.title: UK: UK's Labour wins key seat of Crosby-ITN.
newsitem.headline: UK's Labour wins key seat of Crosby-ITN.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party has won the key constituency of Crosby, previously considered a safe Tory seat and number 120 on Labour's list of most winnable seats.

ITN said the victory represented a swing to Labour of 10 percent. The Conservatives held the seat at the 1992 election with a majority of 9,591, despite a three percent swing to Labour. The urban seat is largely white collar with 80 percent of households owning their own home.
Political commentators said before the election if Labour wins the Crosby seat, Tony Blair's party it is on course for a landslide victory.
